The evidence indicates a possible dependency on Dl-Anabasine to mediate the interaction between Bremelanotide and U373 MG, suggesting a potential therapeutic role in targeting this cell line. The integration of these relationships highlights a complex network of molecular interactions that could be leveraged for future research and therapeutic development.
